records.name: Tucumán
records.summary: This division was covered by the dedicated country dossier, which identified no deviation from the national position material enough to score separately (±0.02); it is therefore assessed at the national score. The national frame is what matters here: the 2025 hate-crime record (227 murders, +62% on 2024, most perpetrators police or public-space strangers) and the February 2025 presidential decrees cutting the Gender Identity Law apply in Tucumán as elsewhere, while the province carries neither the metros' trans sex-work policing nor a documented community presence - and the dossier cautions that at these numbers a single provincial case is a real signal, so a zero should not be read as safety.

records.name: Lower Silesian Voivodeship
records.summary: This division was covered by the dedicated country dossier, which identified no deviation from the national position material enough to score separately (±0.02); it is therefore assessed at the national score. The voivodeship's municipalities recur in the national court history annulling anti-LGBT declarations - annulments the Supreme Administrative Court upheld in May 2022 and on 28 June 2022, holding the resolutions violate the dignity of LGBT people and risk violence - a pattern running in the protective direction across all of Poland.
